title: Randomized reductions to 3-SAT have polynomial witnesses
statement: For every verifier model $E$, every language that randomized polynomial-time reduces to the language of satisfiable CNF formulas of width at most $3$ has polynomially bounded witnesses verifiable by a family of fan-in-two Boolean circuits of polynomial size: membership is equivalent to the existence of a witness that makes the appropriate circuit accept.
caveat: The formal statement uses the relation $\leq_r$, whose definition is not included in the provided definitions; the prose interprets it as randomized polynomial-time reducibility.
